summary: The prepared main checkout already contains the issue's proposed DSpark correction: compute_base_logits calls project_through_lm_head, which uses the standard LM-head applicability gate and invokes quant_method.apply for a valid packed ModelOpt head while retaining dense matmul otherwise. The legacy direct matmul was reproduced with a shape-faithful 2:1 packed fixture, and a focused regression was added for the quantized path plus dense and stale-quant-method boundaries.

tests.what_was_measured: Three focused CPU tests: legacy packed-storage matmul fails before dispatch, current ModelOpt W4A16-shaped head dispatches through quant_method.apply and matches an independent dense reference, dense heads retain dtype-casting matmul, and a stale ModelOpt method on a dense tensor is not invoked. Result: 3 passed.
Related quantized target LM-head selector coverage and boundary behavior. Result: 10 passed.

Script executed on the assigned gfx950: legacy [245,512] x [256,1024] packed-storage matmul raised the expected shape error; current ModelOpt-gated projection returned [245,1024] and matched an independently computed dense torch.matmul reference with max_abs_error=0.0. Output is retained in raw/gpu_projection.txt.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. See reports/j-46812d215bbf/raw/gpu_projection.txt.

remaining_limitations: The reported NVIDIA DGX Spark GB10 (SM 12.1), CUDA 13.0, FlashInfer 0.6.15, and ModelOpt NVFP4 kernel were unavailable; no CUDA graph capture on that architecture was performed.
The target and draft model weights were unavailable, so the radixark_qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4 plus radixark_qwen3.8-27b-dspark serving command was not run.

The gfx950 fixture validates the DSpark projection dispatch, packed-shape failure mode, and numerical plumbing only; it does not qualify NVIDIA ModelOpt kernel execution, full-model semantic accuracy, or a distributed workload.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was required.
The prepared interpreter does not include the ruff module; git diff --check passed, but a ruff check could not be run.
